scopeLimits: Only this MAIN native bound-directory fix and its permanent deep-path regression are qualified; Desktop/WorkDataObservation overlays are excluded.
Two fresh owned-Job synthetic complete journeys passed 14 checks each; they do not establish normal-user Desktop shutdown or the cause of historical unknown actors.
The original full fast process passed unit and all 82 static checks in one invocation. Its 26 conditional unit skips and seven live skips remain skips.
The original phase budgets are unchanged. The 900000 ms whole-file bound was checked using start/end after natural termination; no separate realtime watchdog was installed.
M3 and overall 3.1 are incomplete, including pending Desktop/encrypted/recovery matrices, M4/M5/M6, final packaging/upgrade/rollback and cross-machine/platform delivery.

Selected reports, scripts and synthetic result/event/Job metadata are retained. This archive does not recreate runtime keys, payload binaries, entire NTFS scenes or every transitive historical reference.
No real user migration, real platform sends, push or publication occurred.
